q: Which metal is the least dense?
Explain why copper, not silver, is used for house wiring.
Copper conducts almost as well (100 vs 105) but is much cheaper (9 vs 800 USD per kg).
Use the data to explain why aircraft bodies are made mainly from aluminium alloys.
Aluminium has the lowest density (about a third of iron), so the plane is lighter and uses less fuel; it is cheap; alloys add strength.
